subject.title: fix(tts): defer text settlement for final-mode TTS to eliminate churn (#83511)

question: Should OpenClaw accept `capabilities.tts.voice.captionedFinalText` as a public channel capability and enable it by default for bundled Telegram final-mode TTS after the ACP cancellation bug is fixed?
rationale: The branch fixes a real Telegram TTS churn bug, but it also expands the plugin-facing channel contract and changes existing Telegram final-mode TTS message shape while a related issue requests a separate delivery mode.

options.title: Accept capability after repair
options.body: Merge this direction after the ACP cancellation fallback is fixed, treating captioned final TTS as the default Telegram churn fix and leaving separate delivery to the existing product issue.

options.title: Require delivery-mode design
options.body: Ask for an explicit captioned-versus-separate delivery product shape before merging the public capability/default behavior.

options.title: Pause this branch
options.body: Do not merge the capability yet; keep the canonical issue open until maintainers settle Telegram TTS delivery policy.

recommendation.title: Accept capability after repair
recommendation.body: Merge this direction after the ACP cancellation fallback is fixed, treating captioned final TTS as the default Telegram churn fix and leaving separate delivery to the existing product issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The ACP final delivery and channel capability history makes this the best available routing owner for the API/default behavior decision.
